name: Content Strategy
description: Create a durable, evidence-backed content system tied to audience needs and business outcomes rather than an endless post treadmill.

tasks.name: Define audience and business objective
tasks.objective: Specify audience segments, jobs or problems, relationship stage, business outcome, editorial boundaries, brand constraints, proof requirements, and measurement plan.

tasks.name: Research audience and distribution environment
tasks.objective: Analyze customer language, sales and support questions, community discussions, search intent, competitor content gaps, owned performance data, and channel behavior. Separate durable needs from trend bait.

tasks.name: Design content architecture
tasks.objective: Build themes, pillar and supporting topics, formats, distribution channels, internal linking or navigation, reuse plan, update cadence, and ownership. Avoid isolated posts with no system.

tasks.name: Create evidence-rich briefs
tasks.objective: For each piece define audience question, unique angle, claims and evidence, examples, CTA, distribution intent, required subject-matter review, and what would make the piece redundant.

tasks.name: Produce and repurpose
tasks.objective: Create the primary asset, then derive channel-native versions without stripping context or inventing new claims. Keep source provenance and version linkage.

tasks.name: Editorial and factual QA
tasks.objective: Check accuracy, originality, tone, accessibility, citations, claims, examples, SEO hygiene where relevant, and whether the content actually answers the audience need before optimizing headlines.

tasks.name: Measure and prune
tasks.objective: Review qualified attention, downstream behavior, assisted conversion or support deflection, updates needed, decay, cannibalization, and reuse. Refresh, merge, or delete content that no longer earns its maintenance cost.
